edges.label: Immaculate Constellation document hosted on Mace's House site
edges.note: The hearing's own index of documents records the route the material took into the record: 'Report, Pentagon, ``Immaculate Constellation``; submitted by Rep. Mace.' Mace chaired the sitting - Shellenberger's statement opens by addressing her as Chairwoman - and it was she, not the witness, who entered the document.
